name: Algebraic Null-Space Framing
description: Replaces the graph-theoretic deadlock definition with an equivalent linear algebra condition over the real numbers. A homogeneous subsystem of equations z_u + z_v = 0 on three variables has a unique trivial solution if and only if all three pairwise equations are present, which mathematically forces the underlying structure to be a 3-clique (triangle). This prevents models from pattern-matching graph terminology and forces them to algebraically derive the 3-clique requirement before applying an efficient search.
